_comment: Pre-interview survey. Questions only (public repo). Rating ids and text/prepare ids are also listed in firestore.rules; keep them in sync.
title: Before we talk
intro: This short survey (about 8 minutes) helps us use your interview time well. Your answers are seen only by the consultant. Leaders see averages across everyone who responds, never individual answers. Please do not include any patient or client information.

domains.label: I can get the data I need when I need it
domains.probe: Walk me through the last time you needed data and could not get it. What did you do instead?

domains.label: I trust the accuracy of the data I use
domains.probe: Where do errors come from, and how do you catch them?

domains.label: The data I use is current enough for my decisions
domains.probe: How old is the data by the time you use it? What decision would change with fresher data?

domains.label: Reporting takes a reasonable amount of my time
domains.probe: Which report costs you the most time? Who uses it?

domains.label: The systems I use work well for my job
domains.probe: What workarounds do you keep (spreadsheets, paper, re-entry)?

domains.label: I have the training and skills to work with data
domains.probe: What would you do with data if you had the skills or time?

domains.label: It is clear who owns and decides about our data
domains.probe: When data is wrong or a definition is disputed, who decides?

ai.label: I am interested in using AI tools in my work
I have concerns about AI use in public health

text.label: If you could fix one thing about data in your work, what would it be?
Which reports do you produce regularly, and for whom?
What would make this project a success for you?

prepare.label: A time when poor data quality, or systems that don't connect, caused a real problem: a missed case, a late report, a wrong decision. Describe what happened, not who was involved.
Ways better data could help that go beyond this project's current scope.
Parts of today's data work that work well and should be kept.
Your top priorities for how data should work here in two to three years.
